text_block_list.text:
—On our way back from heading out, Winning 
Ticket and I stopped by a local 
bookstore...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Ooooohhh, this is...!! 
Woooaaaaahhh!!!

Completely absorbed in the novel in hand. 
And then—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOOOOOOAH, TAISHIIIIIN, 
HAYAHIDEEEEE!!!!

As soon as she returned to the academy, 
she dashed off at full speed toward her 
fellow classmates, Narita Taishin and Biwa 
Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The three of ussss!! Though born in 
different places, from today on, we're 
brothers, aren't weeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Siblings...? What's this out of 
nowhere?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, Ticket... Don't tell me you read 
that? "Romance of the Three Kingdoms".

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"That's riiiight!! I just read it at the 
bookstore and was so moveeed!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's why I wanna be sworn siblings! 
Who's playing who!? Which roles are you 
two taking!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: No way. I'm not doing it.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh, why!? Come on, let's do itttt!! If 
you won't do it, I'll have to find a 
replacement. But still!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I want to be siblings with Taishin! If 
it's anyone else, we'll only ever just be 
friends, waahh!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*, I said no way. Playing childish 
games like that...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Taishin, I understand how you feel, but 
if you don't engage with her, Ticket is 
going to keep making a fuss forever."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Besides, with Ticket's boundless energy, 
she might end up dragging the whole 
academy into playing "Romance of the Three 
Kingdoms."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Worst ever... Fine, I got it, I'll 
do it...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, let's get this over with quickly 
then.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—The Oath of the Peach Garden. If I had to 
choose one from the three generals...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My name is Guan Yu. Upon this beard and 
the Green Dragon Crescent Blade, I wage a 
battle of salvation!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...So, something like this, I suppose. I 
would be the brilliant strategist. Now, 
everyone, follow me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah... Um, it's not like I'm a 
muscle-headed Zhang Fei type or 
anything...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hey... Liu Bei here. I'll right the wrongs 
of the world as the eldest brother, or 
something like that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
All right, tag. Bring it home on the 
anchor leg.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
My name is TicketzOOOOOOOO! I'm so glad 
you did it, big brooo!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Nobody's like that! Are you seriously 
telling me you were moved by it, but can't 
remember what actually happened...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: "Weren't they here? Well then..."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: My name is TicketarOOOOOOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
This is completely absurd. What country 
are we even in, honestly...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, but it's good to expose oneself to 
historical works. The past holds—many 
lessons.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hoh, seems you've got some discerning 
insight, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"There are all kinds of historical tales, 
but I wonder which one Winning Ticket 
could learn the most from?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see, "The Three Musketeers." A French 
play... A tale from a land so rich in 
horse racing resonates with us too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
The “Three Musketeers”... Ah, I think I've 
seen them around.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right. Then let's do that! Let's do 
that one too~!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —Just for a little while. Well then...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My name is Athos. I shall lead you all— 
and guide you to a noble victory!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm Aramis. My track record with the 
ladies is a bit flashy, but hey, what's 
wrong with that?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
My name is TicketzOOOOOOOOOO! I'll do my 
best, big brooooooo!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"They're basically the same! Just play 
either Porthos or D'Artagnan!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: My name is Dalmatian!!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That's—definitely a dog. And one going at 
absolute full throttle, no less.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, learning just a greeting leaves 
things incomplete, does it? Speaking of 
French culture, a ball comes to mind, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"A ball!? Aaaall right, that's it!! Let's 
all go dancing!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Here we gooooo, you two!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Well, it'll certainly bear more fruit than 
just fooling around here.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, yeah, guess that means I'm 
getting dragged along too.

The three of them broke a sweat during 
their dance lesson.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaahhh, so this is the world of 'The 
Three Musketeers'! I'm so movedddd!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Whether this counts as the "Three 
Musketeers" is debatable, though.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this is it! This is what I'm 
talking about!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Emotions I've never known will change me! 
They'll make me stronger!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
From now on, let's search for all kinds of 
moving moments outside of races too!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's head outtt!!!!!! Woooooah, 
Dalmatians are hereee!

And so, Winning Ticket's search for 
inspiration— and definitely not a 
dog—began.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see, "Sengoku era works", huh...? 
Learning from one's own country's history 
is certainly a fine pursuit.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Sengoku era!! I actually know a bit about 
that!!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Taishin! Wasn't there 
someone with the same name as Taishin in 
Japanese history?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Wait, was there a warlord like that? 
Something-Taishin...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Let's see, if I remember correctly...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Taika Reform Taishin!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO, that's amazing, Taishin!!! Having 
the same name as a famous personnn!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
That's the "Taika Reform"! Don't go 
turning me into a historical incident!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide was there too, right? Uh, what 
was it again... Kobayakawa Hayahide?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaaa, I believe in youuuu, 
Hayahideeeeーー!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You're wrong. And don't trust it. Betrayal 
flags are popping up all over the place.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Allllright, into battle we goooo—! 
Everyone, march out onto the couuurse!!!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, how busy. But running is 
certainly more meaningful than clowning 
around.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Well, if you're gonna run, I wouldn't 
mind joining you.

The three of them dashed about fiercely 
like warlords of the Sengoku period—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
This is... THIS IS SENGOKU!!!!!! Whoaaa, 
I'm so moved!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, it's less 'Warring States' and more 
just ordinary training, though."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this is it! This is what I'm 
talking about!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Emotions I've never known will change me! 
They'll make me stronger!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
From now on, let's search for all kinds of 
moving moments outside of races too!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Allllright, let's go!! Let's build a fine 
nation, Honno-jiiiiii!!"

I'm not sure what brought it on, but she's 
all fired up. And so began Winning 
Ticket's quest for inspiration.
